title: Inject a message into a live AI call
summary: One REST command, calling.ai_message, addresses a running call by id. Its params carry a system message, a global_data merge, or a reset with a new system prompt.
scenario: Your CRM finishes a lookup after the call started and tells the agent who is on the line

folds: variant: poll for application input during silence (functions_on_speaker_timeout)
